system.description: A Focus for a character who commands metal and magnetic force.

abilities.name: Craft Metal
abilities.description: Shape metal without heat and gain an asset for tasks involving metalworking.

abilities.name: Move Metal
abilities.description: Exert force on nearby metal or disrupt electronics and machine creatures.

abilities.name: Sense Metal
abilities.description: Detect nearby ferromagnetic metal, including its amount, type, and general location.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Eyes
abilities.description: Sense electromagnetic fields to see in darkness and perceive hidden creatures, metal, and electronics at long range.

abilities.name: Electromagnetically Charge
abilities.description: Draw on ambient electromagnetic energy to reduce a wound or recharge a mundane electrical device; the cost increases until recovery.

abilities.name: Repel Metal
abilities.description: Gain an asset to block or dodge attacks that include metal.

abilities.name: Guide Bolt
abilities.description: Guide metallic ammunition to gain an asset and deal 3 additional damage once per round.

abilities.name: Rend Metal
abilities.description: Tear apart a visible metal object of up to level 3, with an eased attack against unwilling equipment.

abilities.name: Magnetic Field
abilities.description: Pull incoming metallic projectiles to the ground and disperse electromagnetic energy attacks for one round.

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.description: Permanently magnetize or demagnetize a touched object, or create a field that repels low-level metal.

abilities.name: Command Metal
abilities.description: Reshape nearby metal, combine objects, move the result, or attack a target for 7 damage.

abilities.name: Iron in the Blood
abilities.description: Sense and manipulate trace iron in flesh and blood to move or attack creatures with your metal powers.

abilities.name: Diamagnetism
abilities.description: Make nearby nonmetallic objects respond to your other magnetic powers as though magnetized.

abilities.name: Iron Punch
abilities.description: Hurl a heavy metal object at a nearby target for 10 damage on a successful Intellect attack.
